help.title: How to fill in the file
help.line1: One row = one elevator. Repeat the building columns (Name, Address, ...) on every row of the same building.
help.line2: Rows with the same Name and Address are joined into ONE building with several elevators.
help.line3: A row with a building but an empty Elevator column creates only the building.
help.line4: Required columns: Name and Address. Everything else is optional.
help.line5: RMS frequency: 1 = every month, 2 = every 2 months, 3 = every 3 months. Empty = every month.
help.line6: Delete the example row before you upload the file.
help.line7: Limits: at most 500 data rows and 2 MB per file. Formats: .xlsx or .csv (UTF-8, delimiter ; or ,).
help.line8: Buildings that already exist (same Name and Address) are not created again.
help.line9: Map coordinates are not imported; use 'Locate on map' on the building later.
